description: Implications of AI and Data Center Service Demand on Energy, Water, and Economic Systems is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Stephanie Morris, Thomas B. Wild (Joint Global Change Research Institute (JGCRI)). This talk focuses on the challenges posed by the rapid growth of data centers (DCs), which rely heavily on electricity, water, land, and mineral resources, and have significant interactions with economic growth. The U.S. leads in DC deployment, but understanding how resource demands and constraints impact DC expansion requires strategic multisector analysis.
